sentence: This project studies how inflammation in arteries and problems in the cells lining blood vessels lead to plaques that can cause heart attacks and strokes.
This project studies how ticks pass disease-causing germs to their offspring and how the tick life cycle and germs interact at the molecular level.
This project provides microscopes and technical expertise so researchers can study microorganisms and how they relate to host tissues and their environment.
This project uses machine learning and data mining to build computer models of how two kinds of enzymes carry out their reactions.
This project builds an automatic method that detects whether a person has low back pain and how strong the pain is.
This project studies how physical properties of the environment and two types of immune cells shape their behavior toward tumors.
This project tries to find out whether unusual autonomic activity signals anxiety in autistic and nonautistic adolescents.
This project studies how genetic and environmental factors affect how well bacteria do after horizontal gene transfer, using computer and laboratory methods.
This project builds and tests a study design that uses electronic health record data to find out which clinical interventions for sepsis actually work.
This project tries to find out whether the genetic variability of HIV can help identify recent HIV acquisition from cross-sectional samples.
This project builds vision-language foundation models that help screen for eye disease and predict how it will progress.
This project provides a database that lets scientists examine gene expression patterns and the genetic programs behind normal mouse development and its disorders.
This project uses human and mouse model systems to find out which autism-related genes affect synaptic transmission and how they work.
This project uses human cerebral organoids to study how the timing of oncogene induction during development affects the start and growth of glioma.
This project studies how mechanical stress and exercise affect the heart in desmoplakin cardiomyopathy and tests a gene therapy in preclinical models.
This project tries to find the neural and genetic markers of laryngeal dystonia, a condition with involuntary spasms in the laryngeal muscles during speaking.
This project builds deep learning models that combine MRI and blood biomarkers to predict how radiation fails and how long patients with brain metastases survive.
This project builds computational methods that use sequencing data to find somatic and mosaic structural variation and transposition events and their epigenetic effects.
